protocol: v20 rising1d (non-manufactured 1-D benchmark), frozen before any reference solve, training or certification

problem.g: g(t,x) = -0.6 + 0.6 t - 2 (x - 1/2)^2   (decimals are the exact rationals -3/5, 3/5)
problem.psi: psi = d_t g - d_xx g - f = 4.6 + 8 sin(pi x) > 0
problem.contact_multiplier: lambda = 4.6 + 8 sin(pi x) on the contact set
problem.Lambda_justification: c_F <= diam(Omega) = 1 (Omega = (0,1)), so Lambda = 1 >= c_F^2 (Stefan value)
problem.cF2: 1/pi^2 rounded upward from a 192-bit arb ball (reliability.cF2_upper(1), the Stefan value)
problem.triple: u_theta = B N_theta, free flux S_phi, lambda_psi = M_psi^2 (square head)
problem.data_enclosures: sin(pi x) by arb ball evaluation (sin_pi / cos_pi on arb balls, outward to floats in the NumPy backend); g, g_t = 3/5, g_x, g_xx = -4 exact (rationals enclosed by bk.rational)

training.code_path: experiments/stefan_core._train_one_run (torch.manual_seed(seed); NeuralTriple; TrainingSampler(seed); training.trainer.train), with the problem object replaced
only_differences: problem data functions (f, g, u0) and problem id 'rising1d'
training.monitoring: read-only, every 500 Adam steps (and after L-BFGS): loss components (history.csv keeps every step), max lambda_psi and fraction of the 5000 interior collocation points with lambda_psi > 1e-6 (no_grad forward of the multiplier net; no RNG use); test: monitor on/off gives bit-identical weights
training.rule: no seed is discarded or retrained

certification.pipeline: Stefan pipeline unchanged: TM1 enclosures (certification/enclose/engine.TripleEncloser, mean_value False), per-term split (engine.split_terms), NumPy outward backend (intervals_np), Arb final reduction (upper_sum.reduce_upper_sums, 128-bit arb dot, upper endpoint), direct bounds in 192-bit arb (reliability.direct_projected_bounds)
certification.adapter: new Rising1DAdapter (data as TM1s, sin(pi x) by _taylor1 with arb point/range enclosures of sin_pi, cos_pi)

partitions.volume: uniform dyadic n x n on (0,1)^2, n in {512, 1024} (upper_sum.uniform_2d)
partitions.traces: uniform 1-D, trace_n = 4096 cells at t = 0 and t = T (as Stefan)
partitions.headline: 1024^2; 512^2 rows reported as well

certification.backend: numpy (validated outward float64); batch 512; arb reduction precision 128 bits for the sums (as Stefan), 192 bits for every derived bound
certification.lower_sums: new output (Task 2) enabled for rising1d: L_tau = sum |K| inf_K tau^2, L_gradvhat = sum |K| inf_K (d_x v_hat)^2, lower endpoints rounded downward, arb sum, lower endpoint
certification.slack_quadrature: float64 Gauss q = 3 per axis per cell on the same partition (as the Stefan split rows); t = 0 trace q = 3

validated: G_AR = (a + sqrt(a^2 + 2(U_0 + 2 U_c)))/2, a = sqrt(U_S) + sqrt(cF2 U_R)
N_lo = max{sqrt(L_tau) - F_dir, sqrt(L_gradvhat) - G_AR} (validated_lower_bound, 192-bit arb, rounded down)
reported_quantities.per_term: U_R, U_S, U_0 (= U_I), U_c; shares of F_dir^2 (U_S, U_0, 2U_c, L); slacks U/I (float64 integral of the same density on the same partition)
reported_quantities.wall_times: leaf eval, trace eval, reduction, total
reported_quantities.diagnostics_task4: E(v_hat), ||sigma_h - tau||, ||d_x(u_h - v_hat)||, ||u_h - v_hat||_{L2(Q)} (each also / N_ref), effectivities F_dir/||sigma_h - tau|| and G_AR/||d_x(u_h - v_hat)||, N_lo/N_ref; contact table at t in {0.15, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1}; post-hoc multiplier exact-integral G_AR/N_ref (trained lambda_psi and mu*, v19 A2 definition) on the 1024^2 partitions (q = 2 as v19); figure data 512 x 512 midpoint grid, seed 0
reported_quantities.E_v_hat_definition: E(v_hat) = sqrt(||sigma_h - tau||^2 + ||d_x(u_h - v_hat)||^2 + ||(u_h - v_hat)(T)||^2) with sigma_h = -d_x u_h (diagnostic_float64; reference)
reported_quantities.reference_status: every quantity computed from the finite-difference reference is diagnostic_float64 and labelled reference; reference uncertainty = |fine - coarse grid value|

reference_solver.scheme: implicit Euler in time, P1 FEM with mass lumping (= 3-point FD) in space, primal-dual active set per step (c = 1e0 in the active-set rule lambda + c (g - u) > 0)
reference_solver.reference: finer grid (4096); uncertainty = difference between grids
reference_solver.interpolation_for_diagnostics: u_h: continuous piecewise linear in x, piecewise linear in t between time levels (u_h(0) = u_0)

pre_specified_expectation.statement: at 1024^2, F_dir/N_lo < 1/2 and G_AR/N_lo < 1/2 on all three seeds
pre_specified_expectation.note: all seeds are reported whatever happens

rule: no further budgets, no adaptive refinement, no retraining in this task; problem data, training configuration, partitions and reported quantities are not changed after any result is seen; any forced change is a D-number and all three seeds are rerun under the changed protocol, both versions reported
